rules.statement: Land that was chena for at least 60 years prior to the passing of Ordinance No. 12 of 1840, and which has not been granted or taxed within 20 years of its passage, is presumed to be forest land belonging to the Crown.
rules.supporting_quote: "If it had been a chena for sixty years since 1840, the Ordinance No. 12 of 1840 applies. If it has ceased to be a chena and is now a forest, then too the Ordinance applies."
